description: Find the foreign-key paths between two tables and return the SELECT with the JOINs already written. If the script carries data, every path is EXECUTED and they are ranked by the rows they actually return — a short path that yields zero rows joins nothing. Hub tables (related to almost everything) can be set aside, since they connect any pair without explaining anything.

avoidHubs.description: Set aside tables that are related to almost every other one

sql.description: CREATE TABLE… (PostgreSQL) plus its INSERTs, if you want ranking by real rows

name: db_join_path
title: How two tables join
